  "overall_experience": "The Help Desk Manager found Freshsales to be a highly intuitive and user-friendly platform, simplifying sales process management within their small IT services company. However, the reviewer noted that while effective, the platform could benefit from more advanced functionalities and more robust reporting features to fully meet their evolving needs, and also mentioned the absence of automatic reminders."
